newsitem.title: USA: Rayonier sees full-year net above 1996.
newsitem.headline: Rayonier sees full-year net above 1996.

text.p: Rayonier Inc said on Monday that improving markets for fluff and specialty paper pulps should help the company post better results for its third and fourth quarters than it did in the second quarter and an improvement for full-year 1997 over 1996.
Improved markets for New Zealand timber and log trading from the United States and New Zealand also should help its second-half and full-year results, the company said in a news release.
Rayonier on Monday released second-quarter results that included earnings per share of $0.67 per share, compared with $0.51 per share for the same period a year ago.
